tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background. `foreground` and `muted-foreground` text sit on it.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text on `background`, `card`, `popover`, `secondary` and `accent`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Surface for cards, panels and the sidebar on `background`. Text uses `card-foreground`.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Floating surface: dialogs, sheets, menus. Text uses `popover-foreground`.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action: default button, action links, selected chip, tab indicator. Deep sage in light (5.6:1 with `primary-foreground`); brand sage in dark.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button and resting chips. Text uses `secondary-foreground`.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Subtle fills: skeletons, switch track, table header. Text uses `muted-foreground`.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, dates, hints and placeholders on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `secondary`. 14px minimum (12px only for uppercase labels and badges).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Active or highlighted item in menus, navigation and row hover. Text uses `accent-foreground`.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, field errors and error text on `background` and `card`.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `destructive` fill.

tokens.name: destructive-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts. Text uses `foreground` or `destructive`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state: live, saved. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success alerts and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending state: scheduled, unsaved changes. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning alerts and badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational state: draft, notes. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of informational alerts and badges.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and decorative card borders. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Border of fields and controls (3:1 on `background`, `card` and `popover`).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with a 2px offset. 3:1 or more on `background`, `card` and `popover`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Brand sage for decorative fills (illustration, indicators). Never for text on `background` in light.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Background of the sidebar and the bottom bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Resting navigation text.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Active or hovered navigation item.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text of the active navigation item.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: Welcome and onboarding. Once per screen. Newsreader at display size.

styles.name: text-h1
styles.usage: Screen title (Home, Your Reflections, Guided Journeys).

styles.name: text-body-sm
styles.usage: Hints, dates, metadata. Minimum for running text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and items in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of fields and small buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile and page side margin on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections, page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top page margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Breathing room on welcome screens.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Base radius (fields, buttons). The rest derive from it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips, badges and table cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fields and buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large cards, sheets, dialogs, sidebar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Card on hover and menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.
